newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian rubber prices end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian rubber prices end mixed.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were steady at the close, but business was virtually nil due to an absence of buyers, traders said.
"It was a dead day, and moreover, it was a Monday," a trader said, referring to the wariness seen in the market usually at the start of a week.

At the close, the benchmark April RSS1 buyer was quoted at 305.50 cents ($) a kg by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB), unchanged from Friday's close. The board quoted April SMR20 buyer down half cent at 292.50 cents.
